arguments.command:
cd /workspace/task/scratch && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
src=open('report.md',encoding='utf-8').read()
lines=src.split('\n')
out=[];inside=False
for ln in lines:
    if re.match(r'^##\s',ln):
        if inside: break
        if ln.strip()[2:].strip()=='风险': inside=True; continue
    if inside: out.append(ln)
text='\n'.join(out).strip()
open('risk.txt','w',encoding='utf-8').write(text+'\n')
print(repr(text))
EOF
echo "---"; cat risk.txt; echo "---"; md5sum report.md
